name: Lowndes County, MS
findings: Lowndes County has 147 nonprofit organizations. 66 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lowndes County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Lowndes County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 11 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 5 hobby and sports organizations here list public events, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
